title: LogQL compatibility corpus query file
description: One file of LogQL query definitions, loaded by compatibility/loki/corpus. Each definition is a templated query the Loki compatibility harness expands against the seeded dataset and runs against both reference Loki and cerberus.

duration.description: A Go duration, such as 5m, 1h or 1h30m.

description.description: What the definition exercises. It is part of every expanded case's identity.

query.description: The LogQL query. It may use the placeholders ${SELECTOR} (a seeded stream selector satisfying `requires`), ${LABEL_NAME} and ${LABEL_VALUE} (an equality matcher of that selector) and ${RANGE} (the stream's minimum range for the lane).

kind.description: log or metric. When absent it is inferred from the query shape.

skip.description: Load the definition but do not run it unless the harness runs with -include-skipped.

length.description: Window length; the window start is drawn inside the dataset span.

directions.description: Directions a log query runs in. Defaults to both for a log query; a metric query always runs forward.

requires.description: Properties the stream ${SELECTOR} resolves to must have. Each value names a key of the matching index in dataset_metadata.json.

tags.description: Free-form tags. The tag empty-result marks a query whose answer is empty by construction.
